name: eve haze ~Biyaku no Ou-sama~
source:
A plague fell upon a village killing most of inhabitants including both pharmacists. Only the son of pharmacists Diano survived. He found an old book about aphrodisiacs and started his study. At the same time something strange happened to monsters of this country...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一場瘟疫降臨村莊，殺死了大多數居民，包括兩名藥劑師。藥劑師的兒子迪亞諾是唯一倖存者。他找到一本關於春藥的舊書，開始研究。與此同時，這個國家的怪物也發生了奇怪變化……

［摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]］
